message.content:
A cell that contains more than one nucleus is generally referred to as a **multinucleated cell** (also called a **polykaryon**).  
Examples include:

| Cell type | Typical function | Where it’s found |
|-----------|-----------------|------------------|
| **Skeletal muscle fiber** | Contractile muscle cell | Muscles |
| **Osteoclast** | Bone resorption | Bone tissue |
| **Syncytiotrophoblast** | Nutrient transfer in placenta | Placenta |
| **Myoblast** (fused) | Muscle development | Developing muscle |

So if you’re looking for a general term, “multinucleated cell” or “polykaryon” is the correct name.
